create_GTPBot: create a GTPBot instance that runs an external Go engine binary over the Go Text Protocol
run_GTPBot_step: run a GTPBot step to get the next action from an external GTP-compatible agent
review_GTPBot_gtp_cmd: review the GTPBot gtp_cmd method that sends raw GTP commands and parses responses
refactor_GTPBot_close: refactor the GTPBot close method to cleanly shut down the external GTP process
test_GTPBot_restart_at: test the GTPBot restart_at method that replays a game history on a fresh board
